messages:
anna: Heads-up — starting v2 opt-in rollout on the gateway at 20:00 UTC. This is opt-in only via header `x-redwood-api-version: 2`. No config changes for pinned v1 clients.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window 20:00-00:00 UTC. Plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~40m with health checks. Command: `/deploy gateway v2-optin --stages 10,50,100 --window 2400`
mike: Quick compatibility note — internal SDKs default to 'latest' unless explicitly pinned to v1. That could cause some clients to start hitting v2 unexpectedly if they update the SDK.
sophie: I'll implement a lightweight header shim in the gateway that routes v2 header to the new handler path while keeping v1 route intact. That avoids surface changes for most customers. PR ETA ~2h.
oncall-bot: Monitoring thresholds set for this rollout: error-rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency increase >100ms for 10m will trigger an automated rollback alert.
anna: Good. Also adding an entry to release-notes and the API docs noting opt-in semantics and recommended SDK pinning. @mike can you flag a list of Beta customers we should enable first?
mike: I'll compile a short list of opt-in customers (early beta) and set a customer-gated feature flag. We should not enable auto-upgrade for anyone; require explicit header/backends opt-in.
sophie: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/gateway/pull/482 — header shim + unit/integration tests included. CI green except flaky integration in staging which I'm re-running. cc @anna @mike
deploy-bot: Canary started at 1789002000 — stage 10% deployed to us-west-2. Health summary: 200 OK rate 99.94%, error rate 0.03%, p95 latency +8ms. Logs snippet:
```
[1789002001] route /v1/generate header x-redwood-api-version=2 -> matched gateway-shim v2
[1789002002] handler v2 served: token_cost=12 latency_ms=83
```
mike: Doing a quick smoke: `curl -H 'x-redwood-api-version: 2' -sS https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` -> 200, response shape matches new schema but shim preserved v1 envelope.
anna: Nice. Can we add a temporary regression check in the rollout: compare sample outputs for a set of 20 golden prompts; if edit distance > threshold, pause.
sophie: Added simple eval hook to rollout script to run golden set after each stage. Failsafe: any mismatch + >0.2% error triggers pause.
oncall-bot: Canary stage 50% started at 1789003200. Health so far: error-rate 0.07%, p95 +12ms. No automated rollback.
anna: Proceed to 100% if no spike in the next 15m. I'll monitor #incidents and slack alerts. :eyes:
mike: I'll coordinate with SDK team to add explicit docs and emit deprecation warnings for unpinned clients in the next patch release.
anna: If we see error-rate >0.5% for 5m we rollback. I'm on watch until 00:00 UTC. :rocket:
